entries.source: Toggles between a normal or flagpost tactical bars.#WHITE#
entries.target: 战术视图切换：正常或者旗杆。#WHITE#
通用 时空反击伤害

entries.source: A mysterious hole in the beach
entries.target: 沙滩上的一个秘密洞穴

entries.source: Killed your target while having only 1 life left.
entries.target: 当你只剩1滴血时杀死目标。

entries.source:
Stat points allow you to increase your core stats.
Each level you gain 3 new stat points to use.

You may only increase stats to a natural maximum of 60 or lower (relative to your level).
entries.target:
属性点可以提高你的基础属性。
人物等级每升一级可以获得 3 点自由分配。

每项属性基础值上限为 60 点。加点不能超过这个上限，另外属性上限也受你的人物等级限制。

entries.source: You can also make a pledge on Patreon if you prefer.
entries.target: 如果你喜欢的话，你也可以在Patreon 上捐赠。
通用 增加闪电伤害

entries.source: The dragons here are asleep. You may try to steal their treasure... at your own risk.
entries.target: 这些巨龙正在沉睡之中。你可以试着偷走他们的财宝…但是后果自负。

entries.source: This set of robes is made wholly of spider silk. It looks outlandish and some sages think it came from another world, probably through a farportal.
entries.target: 这套礼服完全用蛛丝制成。它看起来充满异国风情，一些智者推测它来自另一个世界，很可能穿越过时空之门。

entries.source: All Hail King Tolak the Fair!

Running man, running man
Your time is ending soon
Running man, running man
Will not save sun nor moons

Running man, running man
Survival growing slim
Running man, running man
You know your fate is grim

Running man, running man
Now's the time to choose
Running man, running man
Your honour or your shoes!
entries.target:
逃跑者，逃跑者
你的时间不多了
逃跑者，逃跑者
日月也无法挽救你

逃跑者，逃跑者
为了生存日益消瘦
逃跑者，逃跑者
你已获悉残酷命运

逃跑者，逃跑者
现在是时候去选择
逃跑者，逃跑者
你的名誉或你的鞋！

entries.source:
Improves your ghoulish body, increasing Strength and Constitution by %d.
		Your body also becomes incredibly resilient to damage; you can never take a blow that deals more than %d%% of your maximum life.
entries.target:
增强食尸鬼的身体，增加 %d 点力量和体质。
		你的身体对伤害抗性极高，任何一次伤害不会让你失去超过 %d%% 最大生命。

entries.source: Us? Ah, no, we are merely instruments for the Master. We have planned for His return.
entries.target: 我们？啊，不，我们只是主人的工具。我们一直在谋划让他归来。

entries.source: Regenerates %0.2f mana per turn, and increases physical and spell critical chance by %d%% while active.
entries.target: 当技能激活时，每回合恢复 %0.2f 法力值并提高 %d%% 物理及法术爆击几率。

entries.source: Damage from necrotic minions increased by %d%%.
entries.target: 来自死灵随从的伤害增加 %d%%。

entries.source:
Since the dawn of time mages have experimented with the elements.
While most mages are content using the Air school, a few of them took their research deeper and created Storm magic.
At its core lies the Tempest, a storm so powerful it can even damage creatures normally immune.

You have mastered storm magic and can now create new Archmage characters that can learn the #LIGHT_GREEN#Storm talents#WHITE#.

Talents:
- #YELLOW#Nova: #WHITE#Unleash a lightning nova around you, dazing and damaging creatures caught inside
- #YELLOW#Shock: #WHITE#Fire a fast bolt of lightning, dazing the target
- #YELLOW#Hurricane: #WHITE#Call down a Hurricane on any creatures you daze, creating a lightning storm around each of them
- #YELLOW#Tempest: #WHITE#Master the Tempest and pierce even through lightning immunities
entries.target:
自始以来法师们进行着各种元素试验。
大多数法师满足于使用大气系魔法，少数人则深入研究，创造出了风暴魔法。
其核心是“无尽风暴”，其威力甚至足以伤害通常免疫闪电的生物。

你掌握了风暴系魔法，现在你可以创建一个新的可以学习 #LIGHT_GREEN#风暴系技能#WHITE# 的元素法师角色。

技能：
- #YELLOW# 闪电新星：#WHITE# 对你的四周施放闪电新星，对周围生物造成闪电伤害并带有眩晕效果。
- #YELLOW# 闪电之击：#WHITE# 发射一道快速的闪电箭，眩晕目标
- #YELLOW# 风暴之怒：#WHITE# 召唤风暴攻击你眩晕的目标，产生围绕他们的闪电对其造成伤害。
- #YELLOW# 无尽风暴：#WHITE# 掌握无尽风暴，甚至能穿透目标的闪电免疫。

entries.source: Shaloren elves have close ties with the magic of the world, and produced in the past many great mages.
entries.target: 永恒精灵与魔法世界有着很强的联系，曾一度出现过许多伟大的魔法师。

entries.source: Skilled archers can fire special shots that pierce, cripple or pin their foes.
entries.target: 技艺娴熟的弓箭手可以射出特殊的箭矢，可以射穿、致残或者将目标钉在原地。

entries.source: This creature is standing in the eye of a powerful storm of psionic forces.
entries.target: 这个生物站在强大的灵能风暴中心。
近战精神黑暗光环伤害

entries.source:
Curses your target, decreasing all damage it does by %d%% for 10 turns.
		The effects will improve with your Spellpower.
entries.target:
诅咒目标，减少它 %d%% 所有伤害，持续 10 回合。
		效果受法术强度加成。

entries.source:
#GOLD#Mental saving throw#LAST#
Increases chance to shrug off mentally-induced effects.  Also reduces duration of detrimental mental effects by up to 5% per point, depending on the power of the opponent's effect.
entries.target:
#GOLD#精神豁免#LAST#
增加你摆脱精神效果的几率，此外，基于目标强度判定后，每超过1点减少5%不良精神状态持续时间。

entries.source:
You reach out with the shadows silencing and disarming your target for %d turns.
		The shadows will deal %d darkness damage to the target and pull it to you.
		The chance to apply debuffs improves with your Accuracy and the damage with your Spellpower.
entries.target:
你向目标伸出影之抓握，将其缴械并沉默 %d 回合。
		影子会对目标造成 %d 点暗影伤害，将它拉到你的身边。
		技能伤害受法术强度加成。
		异常状态命中率受命中影响。

entries.source: Your grapple victim must be able to move to use this talent.
entries.target: 要使用这个技能，你抓取的目标必须可以移动。

entries.source: The target's lite radius has been reduced by %d, and its darkness resistance by %d%%.
entries.target: 目标光照范围减少 %d，暗影抗性下降 %d%%。

entries.source: You cannot change your equipment while sleeping!
entries.target: 你不能在睡眠中切换装备！

entries.source: You must wield a ranged weapon (%s)!
entries.target: 你必须装备一件远程武器(%s)！

entries.source: The Thaloren forest is disrupted. Corruption is spreading. Norgos the guardian bear is said to have gone mad.
entries.target: 自然精灵森林陷入了混乱，到处肆虐着堕落。据说守护巨熊诺尔格斯已经陷入了疯狂。
#LIGHT_BLUE# * +5 力量，+0 敏捷，+1 体质
水晶球看起来对你不起反应。

entries.source: The target is covered in a layer of ice. Its armour is increased by %d, it deals %0.1f Cold damage to attackers that hit in melee, and 50%% of its damage is converted to cold.
entries.target: 目标被一层冰覆盖，护甲提高 %d 点；近战命中它的攻击者会受到 %0.1f 点寒冷伤害，它造成的伤害中有 50%% 转化为寒冷伤害。

entries.source: Deal physical damage equal to your armor (%d)
entries.target: 造成相当于你护甲值的物理伤害(%d)

entries.source:
Creates a time distortion in a radius of %d that lasts for %d turns, decreasing global speed by %d%% for 3 turns and inflicting %0.2f temporal damage each turn to all targets within the area.
		The slow effect and damage dealt will scale with your Spellpower.
entries.target:
在半径 %d 格内制造一个持续 %d 回合的时间扭曲力场，使范围内所有目标的全局速度降低 %d%%，持续 3 回合，并每回合对其造成 %0.2f 时空伤害。
		减速效果和伤害受法术强度加成。
